jobs.name: 4GB Compatibility
jobs.help: Lets the 4GB Patch work without tripping the game's Steam check.
jobs.why: Serves the DRM's self-check a clean copy so the patched exe still launches.

jobs.name: 4GB Patch
jobs.help: Lets the game use more memory, which prevents crashes in later chapters.

jobs.name: Save Anywhere
jobs.help: Pace yourself and save (mostly) anywhere from the pause menu.
jobs.info: Save Anywhere: pause while you're out exploring and press Y (Triangle, or its key on keyboard) to open the normal save screen. Loading that save puts you back where you were standing instead of at the save station. It only works in free roam, never mid-event or mid-battle, the same rule the game uses for its own save request.

jobs.name: Audio Fix
jobs.help: Fixes muffled voices and sound effects, clipping, and the buzz on 7.1 setups.
jobs.why: Replaces the broken audio filter and stereo downmix, and silences the 7.1 buzz.
jobs.info: Audio Fix, made for this patcher: voices and sound effects without the game's accidental muffle, stereo and headphones without clipping, and no more buzz on 7.1. Cutscene videos still play in stereo. Each fix can be switched off in xiii2-audio.ini, in the game's addons folder.

jobs.name: 4GB Patch
jobs.help: Lets the game use more memory, which prevents crashes before you reach gameplay.
jobs.why: LRFF13.exe is 32-bit, so without this it can only ever address 2GB.

jobs.name: Mouse Support

jobs.why: The PC port shipped with no mouse support at all, so this adds it straight into the game's own input code.
